text: This report recommends the 2025 meeting schedule for the Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council's approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Property Standards Committee - Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Approved the following 2025 meeting dates: Monday, January 13, 2025 Monday, February 24, 2025 Monday, March 17, 2025 Monday, April 14, 2025 Monday, May 12, 2025 Monday, June 23, 2025 Monday, July 21, 2025 Monday, September 08, 2025 Monday, October 06, 2025 Monday, November 03, 2025 Monday, December 08, 2025
